# Public-domain import samples

The TXT and text-based PDF contain the same three Aesop fables in this order:
The Fox and the Grapes; The Lion and the Mouse; The Tortoise and the Hare.
Translation: George Fyler Townsend (1814–1900).

Rights source: [Project Gutenberg, Three hundred Aesop's fables](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/21).
The original text is public domain. These small test containers were prepared
from the existing release QA excerpts; chapter numbers and PDF formatting are
test scaffolding. They contain no modern illustrations or recordings.

The import regression checks the real extraction → preparation → chapter parser
path used when dropping a manuscript. It does not synthesize or mock audio.
